sdd.name: Spec-Driven Development
sdd.description: Build a feature or application: a specification carried through planning, implementation, and convergence.
sdd.when_to_use: Building a new feature or application from requirements.

steps.description: Create or update project principles (once per project).
Create or update the feature specification from a natural language description.
steps.args_example: Build a photo organizer with albums grouped by date

steps.description: Ask up to 5 targeted questions to resolve underspecified areas of the spec.
Generate design artifacts: research, data model, contracts, quickstart.
steps.args_example: Use Vite with vanilla JavaScript. Store metadata in SQLite.

steps.description: Cross-artifact consistency analysis across spec, plan, and tasks.
Generate a quality checklist for a domain (ux, security, performance...).
One mini-V iteration: implement the next unchecked task(s) with unit tests, run them. Repeat implement/converge until converged.
Verify the increment against the spec (system-level). Iterate via implement, or converge and ask the user for sign-off.

bugfix.name: Bug Fixing
bugfix.description: Diagnose and repair broken behavior with separate assessment, fix, and verification.
bugfix.when_to_use: Something is broken and you need an assessed cause, scoped fix, and recorded verification.

steps.description: Assess a bug report against the codebase; produce remediation assessment.
steps.args_example: Submitting an empty password crashes the login form. slug=login-crash

steps.description: Implement the scoped fix from the assessment.
Verify the fix against the original symptom; verdict: verified/partial/failed.

assess.name: Idea Assessment
assess.description: Gather evidence on an idea before committing: go / needs-clarification / kill decision.
assess.when_to_use: Deciding whether an idea deserves investment, with or without existing code.

steps.description: Capture and normalize a raw idea into an intake note.
steps.args_example: Let users work offline and sync when they reconnect. slug=offline-mode

steps.description: Gather evidence about the idea from the market, users, and codebase.
Define the solution space and constraints from research.
Produce the go / needs-clarification / kill decision record.
